svg.title: Resuming restores state. It replays effects.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Resuming restores state. It replays effects.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn timeline of five nodes - triage, gather, diagnose, CHARGE and report - with a checkpoint cylinder after each completed node holding 3.2 KB of state, and a jagged red lightning bolt striking inside CHARGE labelled SIGTERM at 41 seconds. Below, a new process loads thread_id inc-4412 from the checkpoint before CHARGE and re-enters it, and two red arrows reach the bank: 240 pounds charged, then 240 pounds charged AGAIN, with the bank crossed out and 'this is the bug' written beside it. The fix is drawn in green: write an intent carrying a derived uuid5 idempotency key into an outbox queue, and let one worker be the only thing that touches money and dedupe on the key.
svg.text: Resuming restores state. It replays effects.
